model.identity_rule: request and response must agree with the configured exact model_id and non-empty revision

endpoint.endpoint_rule: No URL credentials, query string, or fragment; API key is an Authorization header only

request.messages: system prompt plus one user message whose content is sanitized text followed by data URLs for verified image bytes

limits.timeout_scope: serialization, semaphore wait, network request, and response parsing
limits.cancellation: asyncio.Event or task cancellation; in-flight protocol operation is cancelled
limits.image_validation: handle media type, byte length, SHA-256, dimensions, pixels, per-image and total byte limits

response.usage: complete prompt_tokens/completion_tokens or input_tokens/output_tokens is exact; absent or total-only is MISSING and remains None
response.raw_output: returned in memory in ProviderResult only; never copied into audit metadata

caller_boundary: Call through covenia_b.privacy.boundary.extract_with_privacy_boundary in service use cases; the adapter itself contains no business rule conclusion.
protocol_double_evidence: backend/tests/model/test_qwen_provider.py covers exact bytes, 401, 429, timeout, cancellation, disconnect, missing usage, concurrency, queue deadline, limits, identity, and candidate-only parsing.
secrets: COVENIA_QWEN_API_KEY is never written to report metadata, errors, or logs.
